verification.publication_inventory: Explicit source/docs/test/lockfile changes only. No user profiles, cookies, account credentials, vendor binaries, dependencies or build caches staged. Synthetic test credentials reviewed.
verification.source_review: Reviewed the complete authenticated SOCKS5 diff, new bridge and fixtures against the updated threat model. Loopback authentication, mandatory upstream routing, remote DNS, session cleanup, encrypted secrets, byte limits and existing manager IPC checks remain enforced. No new SQL, command execution, eval or untrusted HTML templates.
verification.instructions_review: Reviewed new design, plan and setup instructions. No embedded exfiltration or system-policy override instructions.

limitations: Manual source review and tests do not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
Actual NordVPN account access, simultaneous distinct upstream accounts and separate clean Windows installations remain unverified.
No external penetration testing or scanning was performed.
